features.availability_delay: 0 (uses only inputs available at T)

features.availability_delay: 0 (uses only inputs available at T)
features.formula: (T - observed_at_ms of the latest book sample) / 1000
features.missing_data_behavior: null + reason: no_observation | from_previous_run
features.pit_rule: available_at_ms <= T

features.availability_delay: 0 (uses only inputs available at T)
features.formula: (T - observed_at_ms of the latest depth sample) / 1000
features.missing_data_behavior: null + reason: no_observation | from_previous_run
features.pit_rule: available_at_ms <= T

features.availability_delay: 0 (uses only inputs available at T)
features.formula: 1 if book or depth is missing, from a previous run, or older than its stale limit (book: tier0 120 s, tier1/2 suspect 120 s; depth: by tier), else 0
features.missing_data_behavior: never null
features.pit_rule: available_at_ms <= T

features.availability_delay: 0 (uses only inputs available at T)
features.formula: count of gap records (book|S, depth|S, candle|*|S, market|ALL) with available_at_ms <= T overlapping (T-1h, T]; a gap is KNOWN only after it closed (SCHEMA section 5)
features.missing_data_behavior: never null
features.pit_rule: gap.available_at_ms <= T

features.availability_delay: 0 (uses only inputs available at T)
features.formula: seconds since the latest ws_connected/ws_disconnected/ws_connect_failed of the current run known at T (else since ws_start), capped 86400
features.missing_data_behavior: null + reason: no_run_at_T
features.pit_rule: lifecycle.available_at_ms <= T

features.availability_delay: 0 (uses only inputs available at T)
features.formula: seconds since the current run's ws_start, capped 2592000
features.missing_data_behavior: null + reason: no_run_at_T
features.pit_rule: ws_start <= T (downtime.until_ms)

features.availability_delay: 0 (uses only inputs available at T)
features.formula: 1 if the latest health record known at T is not HEALTHY or lists one of the symbol's streams as not observing, else 0
features.missing_data_behavior: null + reason: no_health_record (fail closed)
features.pit_rule: health.available_at_ms <= T

features.availability_delay: 0 (uses only inputs available at T)
features.formula: 1 if the latest clock record known at T, or the book/depth sample used, is clock_suspect, else 0
features.missing_data_behavior: never null
features.pit_rule: available_at_ms <= T
